description: NaMn₃P₃(HO₆)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four equivalent O atoms. There are two shorter (2.32 Å) and two longer (2.48 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two MnO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.17-2.27 Å. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.33 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-57°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.61 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 54-57°. There are two shorter (1.56 Å) and two longer (1.57 Å) P-O bond lengths. H is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.07 Å) and one longer (1.42 Å) H-O bond length. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Mn, one P, and one H atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Mn and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Mn and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Mn, one P, and one H atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Mn and one P atom.
